(nya)༄༅/ /'dir sku brnyan la snyan shal phul ba'i 'dod don gsol gdab kyi rigs rnams bzhugs so/ /na maḥshākya mu na ye/stobs bcu mnga' ba'i ston mchog

tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// 'dir sku brnyan la snyan shal phul ba'i 'dod don gsol gdab kyi rigs rnams bzhugs so// na maḥshākya mu na ye/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i ston mchog thub dbang nyid// tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs su bzung ba bdag /rnam 'dren khyod rjes slob cing bstan 'gro'i don// sgrub la bar chad kun las rnam rgyal zhing*// khyad par rgyal sras spyod pa rmad byung gis// don gnyis sgrub la med thabs med pa'i mig /mthong byed dbang po'i sgrib g.yogs chu 'dzin 'di// thugs rje'i rlung gis rjes med gtor mdzod cig /mthun rkyen shes bya rig pa'i ltad mo la// thogs med 'jug pa'i 'dren byed ches gsal ba// lung rtogs bstan par phan pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom// rtag 'jo bstan pa'i snang byed bdag byin rlobs// zhes pa 'di'ang dri'i gtsang khang gi thub chen yid bzhin nor bu la/ gegs sel 'dod don gsol ba'i ched du bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis smras pa'o// ༈ //rgyal ba'i zhal lung dri med kyis// lung bstan rgyal tshab kun dga' bzang*// grags pa'i ba dan srid rtse'i bar// g.yo ba khyod kyis rtags su srungs// 'dren mchog khyod kyi phrin las rgyun// mi nub sman 'dogs 'dod pa bdag /sngon las 'phral rkyen gang yin yang*// lta byed dbang po bsgribs pa 'di// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i thur rtse yis// skad cig nyid la nyer bsal nas// khyod bstan mkhas pa'i las gsum la// dbang 'byor ye shes spyan mchog stsol// //zhes pa 'di'ang e waṃ pa chen po'i sku brnyan la gnas skabs 'dod gsol gyi ched du bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis smras pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //'char ka'i nyin byed 'bum gyi mdzes sdug cha// byed pos gcig tu spungs ltar dge legs mtshan// kun nas rdzogs sku lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi// mchod yul bla med nyi ma'i gnyen la 'dud// bsod nams brgya phrag gis bskrun ston mchog sku// skal dman lta byed yul las chas brgal yang*// mthong don bsod nams phung po gzhal dka' ba'i// sku brnyan mjal ba'i lhas bskos dga' ba brtas// gang che nyer spyod phreng dang stong 'khun gyi// yul grur btags pa'i dar dpyangs kyis mtshon pa'i// phyag mchod sdig ltung mthol bshags dge la rang*// phyogs bcu'i ston mchog chos ston 'tsho gzhes gsol// dge bas rnam 'dren nyid dang dgongs gcig tu// smra mchog sa skya'i dad sgrol rnam lnga dang*// kun dga' bzang bstan bshad sgrub mgrin 'jo bas// grangs med phyogs mtshams nor 'dzin mdzes gyur cig

/bdag rgyud legs byas chu klung ji snyed kyang*// rgyal sras spyod pa'i mtshor 'khyil smon lam gyi// mandā rwa bas bsrubs skyes byang chub che'i// rgyu skar rgyal po'i go 'phang mngon bgyid shog /de srid skye ba'i rkang 'thung dal brgyad dang*// 'byor bcu'i yal ga ma tshang med rdzogs par// phyi nang rig gzhung rtogs pa'i me tog dang*// snye ma bstan 'gror sman pa'i gsos 'gyed shog /ratna shī la bod pa bdag cag la// re ltos bcas pa'i gson gshin 'gro ba rnams// sdug bsngal kun 'byung gnas las ring 'phags pa'i// 'gog lam bden par dgyes dgur rtsen gyur cig /ces thub chen sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan la mchod 'bul gyi tshe/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni tshul khrims rin chen gyis bgyis pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dga' tshal sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan grangs med dbus// u dumbā ra gnyis pa mi srid ltar// bstan la mkhas pa'i las byas mang byon yang*// rgyal bas lung bstan kun dga' bzang 'dra su// gang gi zhal skyin rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing*// grangs med cig car lta byed dbang po'i yul// mngon du bgyis dang bsod nams skal ba'i stobs// 'di mthong lhag par yod med 'phyang mo nyug /gang phyir lus brgya sprul pa'i yan lag lnga// dad pa'i khur dub sa la ngal gso snyam// bdag lus longs spyod sgo gsum dge ba rnams// mchod sprin blo yi byed pos sprul te dbul// skye ba lu gu rgyud kyi sdig ltung rnams// mnongs 'gyod kyis mthol slan chad mi bgyid bsdam// 'phags dang so skyes byas pa'i dge ba'i mtshor// 'dzum zer nam mkha'i rna bas bla mar spel// ston mchog legs gsungs bdud rtsi cang 'byin par// bskul tshig snyan dngags bai ḍū'i rgyud mangs brdung*// rgyal ba myang 'das tha ma'i mdzad pa la// dgyes par bskyungs pa'i gsol 'debs gling bu bsgyur// legs byas de nyid kyis mtshon dus gsum gyi// dge tshogs rnam bkra'i tshon par bye ba phrag

/bsgyur te bris pa'i dge legs mtshan ris can// skye dgu'i skyabs kyi dam pa mngon 'gyur shog /de srid skye bar las bzang ma ma yis// dal 'byor rten gyi lang tsho bskyed bsrings nas// tshul khrims rin chen rgyan gsum gyis mdzes par// phyi nang gtsug lag smra ba'i dbang phyug shog /bod yul puṇḍa ri ka'i skyed tshal gyi// dkyil 'khor kun du khyod gsung lhur len pa'i// dge 'dun sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa grangs med kyis// bshad sgrub dbyangs snyan 'byin pas brgyan gyur cig /tshul khrims rin chen can bdag re ltos can// gson gshin 'gro ba sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas// legs sbyangs tshogs zung rab rgyas rnam par shes// bde ldan mgon po'i zhabs drung brdzus bltams shog /ces rab byung 'dod pa'i me phag lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum par rang gi mchod 'bul gyi tshe bris pa'o// ༈ //kun mkhyen bzhi pa'i zhal lung tambu ra'i// 'phrul las 'byung 'gyur lung bstan stong phrag rgyud// 'grol ba'i sgra snyan gyis bsngags kun dga' bzang*// zhes grags yi ge'i rna ba don ldan byed// gang gi legs mdzad chu gter bsrubs pa'i bcud// e waṃ dam pa'i chos rab 'byung ba'i gnas// ngur smrig 'chang ba'i sdom ldan 'dus pa'i sde// kun nas 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang chen du// rtsa brgyud bla ma phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras// bstan srung dbang po bgrang yas ye shes spyan// 'dzums pa med par gzigs rnams padma'i mtshor// ngang pa'i tshogs rab ji bzhin 'du ba der// dri za'i gling bu bye ba'i snyan 'gyur yang*// gyi nar bgyid pa'i chos spyod dge ba'i dbyangs// mgrin las 'jo ba'i ngur smrig 'chang gi tshogs// grangs med 'dus par dgyes pa'i bsnyen bkur bstabs// zhing rdul grangs snyed lus btud phyag 'tshal zhing*// lha rdzas dar 'phan gyis mtshon 'dod dgu'i dpal// 'dzad med rtag 'jo mchod pa'i sprin chen spros// tshe rabs brgyud mar bsags pa'i sdig ltung mthol// 'phags dang so skye'i dge rtsar dga' bar bskyed// smra mchog rnams la chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da'i gsol 'debs gling bu bsgyur// bsod nams rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob phyir bsngo// byang chub bar gyi skye bar dal 'byor gyi// rkang 'thung thos bsam bsgom pa'i yal 'dab rdzogs// lung rtogs yon tan ci 'dod 'bras bu yis// lus can re ba'i yol go 'gengs par shog

/ces e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang chen por dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs su/ dge tshul dkon mchog ming can gyi mang ja'i bsnyen bkur dang*/ dar 'phan dpyangs rgyur yan lag bdun pa'i tshigs bcad du bcas pa 'di'ang bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bgyis pa bkra shis par gyur cig/ ༈ //rgyal ba'i bka' srung gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi gnyen mgon las byed dmag zor sogs// mthu chen bstan srung tshogs rnams tshur dgongs la// bdag cag bsam don las bcol tshul la dgongs// khyed rnams mchod gsol skyabs su bsten pa bdag /sngon las 'phral rkyen las byung nad gdon gyi// nyer 'tshe kun dang dgra 'dre'i gnod pa rnams// khyed zhal dran pa'i mthu stobs nyi ma yis// mun pa'i dpung bzhin skad cig zhi bar mdzod// mthun rkyen 'chi med tshe dang bsod nams stobs// bde dga' dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel la// rtag tu rtsen pas 'di phyi'i don 'grub pa'i// dge legs thams cad bstan srung rnams kyis sgrubs// zhes pa 'di'ang rang gis bstan srung tshogs la snyan shal phul ba'i tshe/ tshul rin pa rang gis bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ //bstan 'dzin dam tshig can la gus brtse yang*// bstan dgra dam nyams tshar gcod las la brtson// bstan srung rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral dang*// bstan dgra'i srog zan zhing skyong gdong bzhi ldan// las mgon 'khor bcas bsten cing mchod pa'i mthus// e waṃ pa yi bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang*// rnal 'byor bdag sogs sdang ba'i dgra 'dre yi// nyer 'tshe bar chad bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod// mthun rkyen dngos grub tshe dang bsod nams dang*// thos bsam bsgom pa las byung yon tan dang*// rnam dkar phrin las thams cad dbyar mtsho yi// ngo mtshar ji bzhin 'phel rgyas phrin las mdzod// ces pa mgon khang nub tu kun dga' bsod nams pa mgon blar bkod pa'i tshe/

'dod gsol nyung ngu 'di'ang bande tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgyal sras lhag pa'i lha// bstan srung nor lha kun 'dus skyabs kyi mchog /mthu stobs bi rū pa dang dbyer med pa'i// dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs kyis rtag tu skyongs// bsod nams brgya phrag gis bskrun khyod kyi sku// ril por bzhugs pa'i mchod sdong srid dang zhi'i// dpal kun 'jo ba'i dpag bsam gang yin la// ci 'dod gsol btab mi bslu gsung don ltar// nyer spyod mar me'i phreng ba brgya phrag gis// mdun bdar mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa bdag /bstan don lhag bsam sgrub la phyi nang gi /bar chad dgra 'dres gnod pa kun las skyobs// bdag la gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan mthu'am// dug can zas sbyar gnod pa gang yin yang*// mthong byed bsgribs g.yogs ngan pas nongs pa 'di// dri bzhon phrad pa'i sprin ltar myur gzhil mdzod// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rin chen mig thur gyis// lta byed bsgribs pa bsal nas shes bya'i gnas// ma lus dri med mthong ba kun mkhyen gyi// ye shes spyan mchog thob par bdag byin rlobs// zhes pa 'di'ang mchod sdong srid zhi'i dpal kun 'jo ba'i dpag bsam la rkyen sel 'dod don gsol ba'i ched du tshul rin rang gis bris pa'o// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang nas 'khor lo'i mgon gyi bar// rim byon rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' dam tshig /rtag gnas gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// dmag zor las mgon bstan srung rgya mtsho gson// bdag cag bstan don bsgrub la mthong byed kyi// sgrib g.yogs bsal nas shes bya kun rig pa'i// 'dren byed rnam gsal myur du thob 'gyur ba'i// phrin las bstan srung dbang po rnams kyis sgrubs// bsam sbyor ngan pa rtsom pa'i dgra bgegs rnams// drag po'i stobs kyis myur du tshar chod la// lta byed dbang po rang byer gsal ba sogs// bsam don la gor 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// bsod nams lhun po'i phrag pa ches mtho las// 'chi med tshe yi gaṅgā rgyun chag babs// lung rtogs yon tan nyi zla'i 'od gsal bas// phan bde'i 'dab stong tshal rab rgyas par mdzod// mdor na bla ma lha srung mthu rtsal dang*// bdag cag lhag bsam smon lam bden pa'i mthus// sgo gsum bar chad mi mthun las rgyal zhing*// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di'ang mgon khang nub shar du rkyen sel gyi ched du bande tshul rin gyis bris so//

༈ //saṅgu ra we na maḥ ston mchog thugs las sprul pa'i nag po che// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang*// las byed mgon po ru 'dren sde tshogs bcas// dam tshig dbang gis bdag la brtser dgongs nas// bdag gi 'dod don bde blag bsgrub phyir du// dngos 'byor yid sprul phyi nang gsang ba yi// mchod sprin rgya mtshos thugs dam gnyan bskang nas// thugs dam 'gal ba'i nyes tshogs mthol zhing bshags// bsten cing sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// bstan dang 'gro don sgrub byed dal rten la// lo zla zhag dus keg dang srir ldang ba'i// nad rigs gdon bgegs bar chad kun zhir mdzod// phrag dog sdug sems 'chang ba'i dgra 'dre yi// 'khyog 'gro khros pa'i byad gtad ngan sngags sogs// dug rlangs 'thul ba mtha' dag bstan srung mchog /khyod zhen dran pa'i sman gyis myur gzhil mdzod// mthun rkyen 'chi med ring 'tshos tshe dpal dang*// bsod nams dpal 'byor rnam dkar phrin las rnams// dbyar dus chu gter lta bur 'phel rgyas klong*// phrin las rlabs phreng bye bas mdzes par mdzod// ces bstan srung dbang po rnams la rang gi 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i las bcol don yod zhags pa zhes bya ba 'di ni lhun grub steng gi mgon khang nub shar du bskang ba stong tshar bsags pa'i snyan shal zhal yig tu bande tshul rin gyis bris par sarba artha siddhantu// ༈ //saṅgu ra we na maḥ rgyal ba'i phrin las bstan srung dbang po'i skur// sprul nas las bzhi'i phrin las gang bcol ba// thogs med sgrub pa'i gnyan mgon gdong bzhi pa// yum bzhi dregs pa'i sde tshogs 'khor bcas gson// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod gtor dam rdzas kyis// mdun bdar thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba dang*// thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes tshogs mthol bgyid pas// gang 'tsham phrin las sgo brgya 'byed par mdzod// rje btsun sa skya pa dang e waṃ pa'i// ring lugs dad 'dun skyong ba bdag lus la// lo zla zhag dus keg dang srir ldang ba'i// nad gdon dgra 'dre'i gnod pa zhi bar mdzod// sngon las 'phral rkyen 'chi rigs thams cad dang*// lta byed dbang po'i sgrib g.yogs bcas pa rnams// bstan srung dbang po khyed zhal dran pa'i mod// nyi mas mun pa'i dpung bzhin zhi bar mdzod// bsod nams ma dros chu gter rgyas pa las// 'chi med tshe yi gaṅgā rtag 'bab cing*// lung rtogs yon tan 'dod 'byung nor bus gtams// mkhas tshul gsum gyi klung brgya 'jo bar mdzod// ces gsang mgon yid bzhin nor bu la rang gi 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i las bcol dpag bsam yongs 'du zhes bya ba 'di'ang lhun grub steng gi mgon khang nub shar du bskang ba stong tshar bsags pa'i snyan shal zhal yig tu bande tshul rin gyis bris par swasti bi dza ya tu//

༈ //gang bcol phrin las la gor sgrub phyir du// mthu ldan rdo rje legs pa 'khor dang bcas// bdag gi dam rdzas mchod pas mnyes gyur nas// bar chad kun bsal bsam don mtha' dag sgrubs// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //bdag cag bstan don sgrub la mthong byed kyi// sgrib g.yogs bsal nas nyes bya kun rig pa'i// 'dren byed rnam gsal myur du thob 'gyur ba'i// phrin las bstan srung dbang po rnams kyis sgrubs// zhes pa 'di'ang rkyen sel gyi ched du bris pa'o// bsam sbyor ngan pa brtsam pa'i dgra bgegs rnams// gang 'dul thabs kyis myur du tshar chod la// bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i lha srung khyed rnams kyis// bsrung ba'i gur khyim bdag cag rtag 'tshor mdzod// ces pa 'di'ang rkyen sel gyi ched du bris pa'o// ༈ //rgyal bas bstan pa bskyang bar gnyer gtad pa'i// mthu stobs dpag yas gur mgon lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi ldan pa las mgon bka' srung tshogs// thams cad tshur dgongs dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas 'bul// bstod dbyangs rol mo'i nga ro lhan cig nyid// phyi nang mchod sprin spyan gzigs gnam sa'i khyon// dog snyam byed sprul 'bul ba 'di bzhes shig /sbyin bdag 'khor bcas 'di nas byang chub bar// nad gdon bgegs dang dus min 'chi rigs kyi// gnod pa mi 'byung bsrung ba'i gur khyim na// tshe dang bsod nams dge chos 'phel bar mdzod// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu/ ces pa kun dga' blo gsal gyi ngor/ tshul rin gyis so// ༈ //swasti bi dza yantu/ kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang nas sa skya pa// brgyud par bcas dang bdag gi yongs 'dzin bar// ji ltar bgos pa'i 'phrin yig thugs kar bkod// dam tshig rdo rje'i rgyas btab la gnas pa'i// yid la bsam pa'i dngos grub ci dang ci// thogs med sgrub pa'i rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs bdag /rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang*// las kyi mgon po pho nya 'khor bcas dang*// las bzhi'i phrin las gang bcol la gor du// sgrub mdzad gnyan mgon chen po zhal bzhi pa// 'jigs rung yum bzhi dregs pa'i sde tshogs bcas// dur khrod dmag zor re ba tī la sogs// rtag tu bstan cing bsgrubs pa'i lha srung rnams// deng 'dir dgos pa'i don chen bcol ba ni// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sgo brgya phye ba las// 'dod don sbyin pa'i phyag ring brkyang bar mdzod// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lung rtogs bstan pa spyi// de tshul smra ba'i rgyal po sa skya pa// thabs shes yi ge'i mtshan mnga' yab sras bcas// bstan pa rgyas shing bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan mdzod// gang de'i lugs bzang legs bris grong khyer bzhin// dad stobs lhun po'i phrag pa ltar brling ba'i// sde bzhi dge bcu'i sa chen skyong ba'i lha'i// rigs kyi bum chog myur du 'byung bar mdzod// rnam sad lha dang mi dbang gdengs can gyi// skye ba 'phos pa'i rigs mchog bstan jus la// phan pa'i phrin las 'khor lo phyogs bral du// bgrod la las dbang gnam gyis bskos par stsol// de tshe mi dang mi ma yin pa yi// byad gtad 'khrul 'khor bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi// sbrul gdug kha rlangs dug gis mi tshugs par// zhi byed sman gyi bdud rtsis bsal mdzod cig

/lha klu mi yi skye 'gro thams cad kyi// 'chi med tshe yi gaṅgā'i rgyun chen de// bsod nams gser gyi sa gzhir 'khyil ba'i nang*// dge legs chu skyes 'bum phrag dgod par mdzod// 'khor 'das las bzang dar bab mdza' na bo// yid 'phrog dbang gi phrin las mdzes dga' ma'i// zur mig bskyod pa tsam gyis rigs sras de'i// bsod nams khang par khugs shing 'dun par mdzod// chos dang thar pa nor 'dod phywa g.yang rnams// rigs sras 'di yi dbang du khab len rdos// lcags phye lta bur sdud la bar chad bgegs// mngon spyod las kyis bskrad gzir phrin las mdzod// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i snye ma g.yur za ba'i// dge bcu'i yal 'dab phyogs su rgyas pa'i khrod// thog mtha' bar dge'i chos kyi me tog dkar// rnam bkra shis pa'i dri bsrung rtag 'jo mdzod// rgyal gsung mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i dka' ba'i gnas// thub mchog nyid dang dgongs gcig smra ba'i mchog /brtse chen sa skya pa dang kun bzang gi /lugs mchog rgyas pa'i rtsa lag dam pa sgrubs// mkhyen dpyod longs spyod 'khor lo grol ba las// 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i sgra dbyangs 'bum 'jo ba'i// mkhas btsun grub pa'i bstan skyong grangs med kyis// phyogs bral gdul bya'i dpal du brgyan par mdzod// de 'dzin dge 'dun 'dus pa'i thun mtshams sprin// dmar mdangs nor 'dzin bzhin ras yongs bkab par// mtshungs kyang bshad dang sgrub pa'i dbyangs ldir bas// khyad par 'phags pa'i khur gyis lci bar mdzod// de mthu'i nyid mor byed pa'i 'od stong gis// chab 'bangs kyis mtshon yangs pa'i 'jig rten khams// nad dang bkres rngabs 'thab rtsod mi dge'i mun// skad cig gnyis par gnas su ma ster cig /ring 'tshe'i tshe dang lhas bskos dpal 'byor stobs// sgo gsum dge spyod phan tshun mdza' gcugs yid// bde ba rgyur bcas 'jug pa rdzogs ldan gyi// skal bzang 'di na yongs su 'phos snyam mdzod// bla ma mchog gsum bden pa'i sprin gyi sgrar// lhag bsam mdongs mtha'i mu mo rab dga'i 'gyur// mngon 'dod smon lam zlos pa'i gar bsgyur ba'i// ngo mtshar skye dgu'i mig lam smin gyur cig

/ces pa kun 'dzin gnam lo gsar tshes kyi// hor zla drag por rmi ltas 'khrugs pa'i skabs// 'dod gsol rkang mgyogs grub pa'i pho nya 'di// legs dgu 'dzoms pa'i yang thog pho brang bris// sarbārtha siddha bha wa tu/ zhes pa 'di'ang sa skyong rigs kyi khye'u'i mtshan rtags mi 'gyur ba'i 'dod gsol du bande tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas/ bstan srung gnyen po rnams la gtor ma stob pa dang lhan cig bris nas phul ba don thams cad grub par gyur cig/ ༈ //na mo gu ra mo gha siddha ya/ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul bstan srung dbang po'i skur// bzhengs nas zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnams// gang bcol thogs med sgrub pa'i mthu stobs dang*// rdzu 'phrul dpag yas dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa// yum chen sring bzhi bka' 'khor sde tshogs bcas// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// sbyin bdag dam tshig nyams chag bskang ba dang*// khyed thugs 'gal ba'i nyes skyon mthol zhing bshags// bsrung bya'i lus kyi bde ba 'phrog byed pa'i// nad rims gdon bgegs dgra 'dre'i gnod pa dang*// dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs tshogs nag po'i sprin// mthu stobs dri bzhon shugs kyis bsal bar mdzod// ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe dang bsod nams stobs// dbang thang dbyar skyes dga' tshal rgyas pa'i khrod// sa skyong rigs mchog sā la'i rkang thung phreng*// kun mkhyen bstan pa'i dpal du bskyed bsring mdzod// srid zhi'i bde 'byor dgugs la mi mthun phyogs// gzugs can gzugs med bsam sbyor lha min dpung*// mngon spyod lha dbang rdo rjes nyer bcom nas// bde 'byor bdud rtsi'i dga' ston rtsen par mdzod// ces gnyan mgon chen po gdong bzhi pas sa skyong rigs kyi dpag bsam sdong bu bskyed pa'i gegs 'phrang bsal ba dang mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'i rmi ltas dge ba shar tshe slar yang myur mgyogs dran bskul gyi tshul du 'dod gsol lha dbang rdo rje zhes bya ba 'di dang khyad par gyi bskang gso stong rtsa 'don par bskul ba dang lhan cig tu snyan shal zhal byang du stong 'khun yul grur lbu tsir bod pa'i gnam lo'i zhag mdzod gsum pa'i dbang po'i tshes kyi nyin bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris nas phul ba la/

srod dus su 'dod don grub pa'i dge mtshan yang byung ba sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //sarbārtha siddhwa bha ba tu/ dkon mchog gsum dngos rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// dgyes mdzad rdo rje la sogs yi dam gyi// bka' lung rdo rje'i rwa bar gnas bcas te// rnam bzhi 'phrin las sgrub pa'i mthu rtsal can// rdo rje gur mgon dral lcam bran g.yog bcas// zhing skyong dbang po gdong bzhi yum chen bzhi// las byed mgon po gnod sbyin yab yum dang*// pu tra ming sring ru 'dren sde tshogs bcas// dmag zor dur khrod beg tse lcam dral sogs// bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i lha srung gnyan po rnams// da ltar tshul dgongs phrin las bcol ba ni// 'di na dam tshig can gyi sa skyong mar// phyi nang 'byung tshogs 'khrugs pa'i nye zho'am// mi dang mi min gnod byed gdon bgegs kyis// gtses pa'i lus ngag yid kyi nad gdon dang*// dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen ngan gang yin yang*// bstan srung khyed cag yon tan dran kyin dad// mchod gtor rgya chen gyis bstabs bsten pa'i mthus// thun gsum mun khrod sgron me bteg pa ltar// skad cig nyid la zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// yus pa'i bu chung brtse ba'i ma ma la// ngud mos 'bod ltar bdag nus ma 'tshal bar// mthu ldan khyed rnams dpung grogs bcol ba la// 'gal rkyen sel ba'i mthu rtsal ma chung cig /sngon las 'phral rkyen bar chad tsher ma'i dpal// gang dag gzengs pa mthu stobs bskal pa'i mes// skad cig gnyis par gzhob tu thul bsregs nas// khyed cag bsrung ba'i gur khyim rtag gnas mdzod// bla ma lha srung rnams kyi thugs rje dang*// dam tshig can gyis mchod bstod bskul ba'i mthus// nor 'dzin skyong ma bar chad kun bral nas// tshe dpal dbang thang dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /ces bstan srung dbang po rnams la las bskul bskal pa'i zhugs chen zhes bya ba 'di ni lha lcam bkra shis dbang mo'i keg 'phrang tsher ma gzhom pa'i phyir/
rab byung chos 'khor gyi grangs mnyam gyi nang gsel sarba dha ri zhes pa'i gnam lo'i zla

3 tshes 9 la bande tshul khrims rin chen gyi sde dge 'dzoms thog pho brang du 'phral la bris pa dge legs rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ ༈ //na mo gu ru dya/ rdo rje 'chang nas bdag gi 'dren mchog bar// bar chad bsal nas mthun rkyen ci 'dod kyi// dngos grub lag rtser sbyin pa bka' bskos shing*// rtag tu mchod kyin sgrub pas bsten bgyis pa'i// bstan srung gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon gnod sbyin yab yum dang*// pu tra ming sring ru 'dren sde tshogs bcas// dur khrod dmag zor beg tse lcam dral sde// khyed cag ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan gsal zhing*// rdzu 'phrul gom pas stong gsum yud kyis bskor// mthu stobs thogs thugs med pa'i phyag rkyong la// bsam don dngos po bsgrubs pa'i sdong grogs mdzod// bde skyong bgrang phreng mdzes byed rgyan dang bcas// bor stor ma byin blangs pa su zhig gis// lag tu chud pa bgor ba rang dbang du// gegs med 'byor ba'i mthu rtsal ma chung zhig /gzhan nor rbad rkun byed pa'i las ngan mkhan// rnam smin ltas ngan cho 'phrul brgya stong gis// lus la mi bde sems la smyo 'bog dang*// sngangs skrag bzod dka' du mas yid bsgyur cig /bdag 'khor bcas pas gzhan la dris btsal yang*// ma rnyed smra ba'i gal rdzun nyes pa can// mthu chen bstan srung khyed rnams gnyen bskul ba'i// yid la re ba'i 'bras bu 'grub par mdzod// 'jab bus brku 'phrog ngag gi bden min smra// gzhan dbyig brlag 'tshong byed pa'i dgra byung na// lus la bro 'tshal dag gi gsang don brtor// yid 'khrugs mtshang rtags sma tshogs de lta ston// sa ma yasma ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ces dgos skabs kyi las bcol bsam don 'gugs pa'i pho nya 'di'ang tshul rin gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/
slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
